scope: 只读开发树的公开课程与词典及既有验证证据，不读取个人学习档案、服务配置或凭据；正式发布树未检查。

formalStableVersion.basis: 父任务提供的状态；本次未读取正式目录以独立核实

priorPublicPreservation.interpretation: 0.0.112 到 0.0.114 的 1912 原材料、365 原课表及 7 旧关联单元保持情况引自该本机报告；本次未重新读取历史快照逐项比对。

linkedTargets.method: 每个单元按 canonicalId 去重；词库核心词头和词典核验的扩展词头分开计数；已知 spellingVariants 归入同一核心词，不另加目标。heating/freezing 词义决定见词义复核来源；不是无限词形或个人历史去重的证明。

sourceContextCoverage.meaning: 这些目标在对应公开阅读原文中有准确词面及句子引用，仅表示内容绑定，不表示学习或掌握。

targets.meaning: 操作说明中的一条指示
足球（美式英语常说 soccer；football 也可指美式橄榄球）
供暖系统；美式常用 heat

moduleCounts.countingMethod: 只统计17个关联单元 task.materialRefs 引用的独立材料；questions 统计材料中的 questions 数组；主观写作与口语另计 prompt 任务，词汇材料另计训练词，不能以 questions=0 理解为没有练习。

addedV114Audio.verification: 词音与听力直接对照公开单元 pins；分段对照材料 oralModelAudio pins；整篇口语对照来源清单。全部再对照来源清单及安装文件字节和 SHA-256。

audioReview.method: Source hashes, actual decoding, role pauses, precise segment generation and independent unprompted offline ASR; raw mismatches retained.
limitations: ASR is not phoneme or intonation certification. A few listening homophones/short words remain recognition ambiguities, not proven spoken errors.
Whisper timestamp-tail filtering affected two initial runs; raw PCM was unchanged and padded/context retries retained.
Segment timing beyond appended silence is diagnostic, not proof of acoustic content.

addedV114Audio.limits: 本次仅核对音频路径、文本/文件绑定与字节哈希；合成音频的发音、语调及 IELTS 分数不能由本清点或 ASR 证明。

segmentEvidenceCopy.scope: Only manifest-referenced segment authoring evidence was copied. Runtime audio, materials, release and root-review were not changed.

provenanceCompleteness.note: References counted by occurrence; source evidence files are non-runtime review assets.

listeningAuditMetadata.scope: Original synthetic TTS metadata preserved with v114 ID remapped; full source/configuration/hash, segment boundaries, role pauses and actual decoded audio were checked in an isolated stage. Does not certify pronunciation, intonation or IELTS scores.

nominalThirtyPerUnlinkedDay.interpretation: 按第2–365天每个未关联课各30个名额作纯算术规划，包含第365天；不代表真实可分配新词、个人缺口或已完成情况。

ordinaryDays2to364.interpretation: 第365天在现有规划中是年度复盘；若不对其预留30个新词名额，按其余未关联课各30个计算。

limitations: 公开材料与其目标词数量不是用户已学、已完成、已掌握或已通过的数量。
仅对已安装的17个关联单元按词头和已登记拼写变体计数；其他教材和个人真实历史可能已有相同词汇，且未覆盖所有词形。
原文可定位和题目数量不证明教学效果、整体语义正确、真实能力或 IELTS 成绩。
早期听力无提示 ASR 仍有短词和同音差异待复核；时间戳/追加静音诊断及原始差异保留在既有证据。
发音、语调和长期学习效果未由文件哈希、解码、ASR 或本次盘点认证。

readonlyCurriculumAudit.method: Programmatic audit-curriculum.audit with explicit GSA and ordinary-reading releases; the CLI was not invoked, so release-audit.json was not written.
readonlyCurriculumAudit.questionCountBasis: material variant instances; paired same-source questions are not additional unseen coverage
readonlyCurriculumAudit.scope: Structural/content checks on public development data only, not personal progress, acoustic listening review or score calibration.
